mapper.insert: SELECT seq_reply.nextval FROM dual INSERT INTO tbl_reply (rno, bno, reply, replyer) VALUES (#{rno}, #{bno}, #{reply}, #{replyer})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tbl_reply WHERE rno = #{rno} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_reply SET reply = #{reply}, updatedate = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE rno = #{rno}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_reply WHERE bno = #{bno}
